title: SyncRunV1
description: Execution summary, pagination telemetry, and cursor watermark state for a collection sync run.

sync_run_id.description: Unique session identifier for this sync execution (e.g. sync_douyin_coll_20260904_153708).

mode.description: Sync execution mode: incremental (watermark-bounded), backfill (historical deep scan), or probe (connectivity test).

status.description: Final or current execution lifecycle status.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the sync run started.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the sync run concluded, null if in-flight.

page_size.description: Fixed count parameter used throughout all pagination requests in this run.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent or worker process that performed the sync.

previous_watermark_cursor.description: Watermark cursor inherited from the prior successful run ($W_{prev}$). Null for full backfill.

new_watermark_cursor.description: Cursor returned from Page 1 (latest window) to be persisted upon completion as $W_{new}$.

stop_cursor.description: The cursor value where pagination halted.

has_more.description: The has_more flag returned in the final fetched page.

pages_fetched.description: Total number of HTTP pages successfully fetched.

items_seen.description: Total items encountered across all fetched pages.

new_items.description: Count of previously unseen items ingested.

reappeared_items.description: Count of known items observed reappearing at the head (re-favorites).

known_items.description: Count of known items observed in their expected positions.

errors_count.description: Count of non-fatal page or item processing errors.
